Stack Time Series Rasters into Multidimensional VRT

Source: R/convenience.R
vrt_time_stack.Rd

A convenience wrapper for gdal_mdim_stack() tailored for time series data. Extracts dates from filenames and encodes them as numeric offsets from an origin.

Usage

vrt_time_stack(
  files,
  pattern = "(\\d{8})",
  format = "%Y%m%d",
  origin = "1970-01-01",
  unit = "days",
  array_name = NULL,
  output = NULL
)

Arguments

files

Character vector of file paths

pattern

Regex pattern with one capturing group for the date portion. Default: "(\\d{8})" matches 8-digit dates like 20230115.

format

strptime format for parsing. Default: "%Y%m%d"

origin

Time origin as "YYYY-MM-DD" string. Default: "1970-01-01"

unit

Time unit: "days", "hours", "minutes", "seconds". Default: "days"

array_name

Name for the data array

output

Output VRT path

Value

Path to VRT file (invisibly), or XML string if output is NULL.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Daily temperature files: temp_20230101.tif, temp_20230102.tif, ...
vrt_time_stack(
  files = list.files(pattern = "temp_\\d{8}\\.tif$"),
  output = "temperature_timeseries.vrt"
)

# Custom pattern for ISO dates: data_2023-01-15.tif
vrt_time_stack(
  files = my_files,
  pattern = "(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2})",
  format = "%Y-%m-%d",
  output = "timeseries.vrt"
)
} # }
